ALTER PROC [syn].[GLOBALCIFGENERATE] AS
BEGIN

TRUNCATE TABLE SYN.GLOBAL_CIF_TABLE;

WITH GETCIF
AS
(SELECT MAX(GLOBALCIF) GLOBALCIF,[GROUP] FROM  SYN.GlobalMatchResults
GROUP BY [GROUP]) 
,
STATUS 
AS
(SELECT COUNT( GLOBALCIF) COUNTCIF, [GROUP] FROM syn.GlobalMatchResults WHERE TAG = 'Y' 
GROUP BY [GROUP] )


--CYCLE2 ADD NEW RECORD

--INSERT INTO SYN.GLOBAL_CIF_TABLE ([Entity]
--,[GLOBAL_CIF]
--,[ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR]
--,[insert_dttm])
SELECT 
case when accountid_cust_nbr like 'CBSec_%' then 'CBC11' 
     when accountid_cust_nbr like 'CBC_%' then 'CBC01'
     when accountid_cust_nbr like 'CBS_%' then 'CBC02'
     else null
     end entity,
B.GLOBALCIF, 
accountid_cust_nbr,
a.[group],
a.globalcif,
dateadd(hour,8,getdate()) 
FROM SYN.GlobalMatchResults A
JOIN GETCIF B ON A.[GROUP] = B.[GROUP]
LEFT JOIN STATUS C ON A.[GROUP] = C.[GROUP]
WHERE TAG = 'Y' AND C.COUNTCIF > 0 AND (B.GLOBALCIF IS NOT NULL AND B.GLOBALCIF <> '');


WITH STATUS 
AS
(SELECT COUNT( GLOBALCIF) COUNTCIF, [GROUP] FROM syn.GlobalMatchResults WHERE TAG = 'Y' 
GROUP BY [GROUP] )

--CYCLE1 RECORD
insert into syn.GLOBAL_CIF_TABLE ([Entity]
,[GLOBAL_CIF]
,[ACCOUNTID_Cust_NBR]
,[insert_dttm])
select  
case when accountid_cust_nbr like 'CBSec_%' then 'CBC11' 
     when accountid_cust_nbr like 'CBC_%' then 'CBC01'
     when accountid_cust_nbr like 'CBS_%' then 'CBC02'
     else null
     end entity,
concat('Global_CIF_',RIGHT('0000000000000000'+convert(varchar,dense_rank() over(order by A.[GROUP])+
    (SELECT CONVERT(NUMERIC,MAX(RIGHT(GLOBALCIF,16))) FROM syn.GlobalMatchResults)),16)) globalcif,
accountid_cust_nbr,
dateadd(hour,8,getdate()) 
FROM syn.GlobalMatchResults A
LEFT JOIN STATUS B ON A.[GROUP] = B.[GROUP]
WHERE 
tag = 'Y' AND B.COUNTCIF > 0 AND (A.GLOBALCIF IS NULL OR A.GLOBALCIF = '') ;

END
GO
